description:
Qwen/Qwen3-32B: OpenAI-style chat completion. An OpenAI-style chat completion from Qwen3-32B: POST messages (up to 16000 chars total) and max_tokens up to 1024; returns the assistant message, the model name, and its token usage. Returns: an OpenAI-style chat completion from the model the service is named for: POST {messages: [{role, content}], max_tokens <= 1024}; returns the assistant message, the model, and its token usage. Messages up to 16,000 characters in total.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_q_verdict_v1/qwen3_32b_chat. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
